AZ,\n    CA,\n    CO,\n    CT,\n    DE,\n    FL\n}\n\nenum VehicleTypeCode {\n    TRUCK,\n    TRUCK24,\n    TRUCK10,\n    COVERED_TRAILER,\n    OPEN_TRAILER\n}\n\nclass RentalOffice\nattributes\n AZ,\n    CA,\n    CO,\n    CT,\n    DE,\n    FL\n}\n\nenum VehicleTypeCode {\n    TRUCK,\n    TRUCK24,\n    TRUCK10,\n    COVERED_TRAILER,\n    OPEN_TRAILER\n}\n\nclass RentalOffice\nattributes\n
